facts.fact: The Gabonese government says loi n° 003/2026 of 5 October 2026, ratifying ordonnance n° 0011/PR/2026, regulates AI-generated or modified content, with article 53 providing detection, marking and metadata transmission for investigations.

GAB.note: Document states nothing on government use of AI.
Document states nothing on sectoral AI.
Document states nothing on AI built or hosted in Gabon.

facts.fact: The government says ordonnance n° 0011/PR/2026 of 26 February 2026, ratified and modified by loi n° 003/2026 of 5 October 2026, strengthens the rules on social networks, cybersecurity and personal data protection.

GAB.note: Document states a right of reply and penalties but names no cut, arrest or charge for speech.
